units.source_text: 我已不再在瞩目的风景和事物中寻找金阁的幻影了。

en.t: I no longer sought the phantom of the Golden Pavilion in striking landscapes and things.

units.source_text: 金阁渐渐变成深刻、坚固、实在的物体。

en.t: The Golden Pavilion gradually became a profound, solid, and real object.

units.source_text: 它的一根根柱子、花格子窗、屋顶、屋顶尖上的凤凰清晰地浮现在我的眼前，仿佛伸手可及似的。

en.t: Each of its pillars, its latticed windows, its roof, and the phoenix on the roof's peak appeared clearly before my eyes, as if I could reach out and touch them.

units.source_text: 它的纤巧的细部和复杂的全貌相互呼应，

en.t: Its delicate details and complex overall form answered one another,

units.source_text: 只要取出任何一部分，金阁的全貌就会响起来，

en.t: and if any single part was taken out, the whole form of the Golden Pavilion would begin to resound,

units.source_text: 恍如想起音乐的一小节，整个乐章就会流泻出来。

en.t: as though, on remembering one measure of music, the entire movement came pouring forth.
